2060-2946-6495-6701.notablePrerequisites: You've had a non-Skeleton creature die under your control this turn.
2060-2946-6495-6701.description:
Activate Cult Conscript by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Cult Conscript.
When Cult Conscript is sacrificed, Szarel triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters equal to Szarel's power on Crystalline Crawler.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Activate Crystalline Crawler twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{B}.
Repeat.
2060-2946-6495-6701.notes:
This combo can put infinite +1/+1 counters on each creature you control except Szarel so long as its power is greater than the mana needed to activate the creature's ability from your graveyard.
If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

1981-2415-2438-3330.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1981-2415-2438-3330.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Leyline of Vitality triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

2728-3967-5662-7957.easyPrerequisites:
Genestealer Patriarch does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent controls a creature.
Rikku does not have summoning sickness.
2728-3967-5662-7957.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two additional creatures.
2728-3967-5662-7957.description:
Declare Genestealer Patriarch as an attacker.
Genestealer Patriarch's first ability triggers, putting an infection counter on a creature an opponent controls.
Activate Rikku's ability by paying its cost, moving the infection counter from the opponent's creature onto a creature you control.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the creature with an infection counter on it.
When the creature dies, Reyhan and Genestealer Patriarch's second ability trigger.
Resolve the Reyhan trigger, putting an infection counter onto another creature you control.
Resolve the Genestealer Patriarch trigger, causing you to create a token copy of the sacrificed creature that is a Tyranid in addition to its other types.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat from step 4.

5078-5645-6666.description:
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0} due to Stenn.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Rook Turret triggers.
Holding priority, activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Resolve the Rook Turret trigger, causing you to draw Sensei's Divining Top from your library, and then discard a card other than Sensei's Divining Top.
Repeat

2493-4377-7370.description:
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying its mana cost.
Kykar triggers, exiling Archaeomancer.
Resolve Walk the Aeons, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Kykar triggers, returning Archaeomancer from exile to the battlefield.
When Archaeomancer enters, it triggers, returning Walk the Aeons from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

1309-1987-2020.easyPrerequisites:
You control an artifact, creature or land that taps to produce at least {U}
Vadrik has at least 2 power.
1309-1987-2020.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, blinking the mana-producing permanent and Salvager of Secrets.
When Salvager of Secrets enters, it triggers, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
1309-1987-2020.notes: You must blink a land as your mana-producing permanent to get infinite landfall triggers.

215-1251-3043.notablePrerequisites: You control at least five creatures with defender.
215-1251-3043.description:
Activate Axebane Guardian by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Axebane Guardian from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Axebane Guardian by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

2999-3490-4050-6996.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2999-3490-4050-6996.description:
Gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Impassioned Orator triggers, causing you to gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers. Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {1}.
Resolve the The Destined White Mage trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control 
Repeat from step 3.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

5686-6972-7330.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Mikey & Mona.
When Mikey & Mona dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Mikey & Mona enters, it triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

2281-5231-6909.easyPrerequisites: It is your precombat main phase.
2281-5231-6909.description:
Cast Carnage by paying {2}{B}{R}. 
When Carnage enters, it triggers, returning Saffi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting Carnage.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Carnage.
When Carnage dies, Saffi triggers, returning Carnage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Carnage enters, it triggers, returning Saffi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Thermopod ability.
Repeat from step 3.

2440-3581-4785-7109.description:
Cast Trusty Boomerang by paying {1}.
Kykar triggers, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
When the Spirit enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each Spirit you control.
Activate Trusty Boomerang's equip ability by paying {1}, attaching it to the Spirit token.
Activate the Spirit token by paying {1} and tapping it, tapping a creature a returning Trusty Boomerang from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
2440-3581-4785-7109.notes: The cost can be reduced to as little as {1} if you control other Spirits. You can also sacrifice the Spirits once you have enough to get infinite {R}.

250-730-779-1479-5413.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
250-730-779-1479-5413.description:
Play Dakmor Salvage.
When Dakmor Salvage enters, Emeria Angel and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, choosing to put nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Trenching Steed by sacrificing Dakmor Salvage.
The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
If a land was milled this way, The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Trenching Steed ability
Resolve the Emeria Angel trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Dakmor Salvage from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Dakmor Salvage enters the battlefield, Emeria Angel triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

1399-1606-5929-7069.description:
Activate a land by tapping it, adding {G}{G}{G} due to Tectonic Split
Activate Ley Weaver by tapping it, untapping Wirewood Lodge and a land
Activate Wirewood Lodge's second ability by paying {G} and tapping it, untapping Ley Weaver.
Repeat.

654-681-4693-6621.easyPrerequisites: Lands you control excluding Mirrorpool can tap to produce at least {2}{C}
654-681-4693-6621.description:
Cast Splendid Reclamation by paying {3}{G}.
Holding priority, activate any number of lands you control except Mirrorpool by tapping them, adding at least {2}{C}.
Activate Overgrown Estate by sacrificing a land other than Mirrorpool.
Repeat step 3 until Mirrorpool is the only land you control.
Activate Mirrorpool's second ability by paying {2}{C}, tapping and sacrificing it, copying Splendid Reclamation.
Resolve the Splendid Reclamation copy, returning all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter, Amulet of Vigor triggers that many times, untapping the lands.
Repeat from step 2.

972-2556-3542.easyPrerequisites: You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {4}{U}{U}.
972-2556-3542.description:
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{U}.
Cast Saheeli's Artistry by paying {4}{U}{U}, creating a token copy of Palinchron that is an artifact.
When the Palinchron token enters, it triggers, untapping up to seven lands.
Cast Mnemonic Wall by paying its mana cost.
When Mnemonic Wall enters, it triggers, returning Saheeli's Artistry from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{U}.
Cast Saheeli's Artistry by paying {4}{U}{U}, creating a token copy of Mnemonic Wall and the Palinchron token.
When the Mnemonic Wall and Palinchron tokens enter, they trigger.
Resolve the Mnemonic Wall token's trigger, returning Saheeli's Artistry from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Palinchron token's trigger, untapping up to seven lands.
Repeat from step 6.
972-2556-3542.notes: If the seven lands can tap to produce {5}{U}{U} or more, this combo will net infinite mana. So long as you produce an extra {U} each loop, you can eventually stop copying Palinchron and copy other creature(s) or artifact(s) instead. You can also create two copies of Mnemonic Wall instead to return other applicable cards to your hand.

104-2645-2919-4929.description:
Activate Staff of Domination's second ability by paying {2} and tapping it, causing you to gain 2 life.
Archangel of Thune and Cleric Class trigger, putting two +1/+1 counters on Cryptic Trilobite and one +1/+1 counter on each other creature you control.
Activate Cryptic Trilobite by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {C}{C}{C}{C} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.
104-2645-2919-4929.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may use it to activate Staff of Domination's other abilities.

1563-2457-4785-6441.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate the Insects by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat

2557-3470-5702-5954.easyPrerequisites: Springheart Nantuko attached to Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
2557-3470-5702-5954.notablePrerequisites: Overlord of the Hauntwoods does not have summoning sickness.
2557-3470-5702-5954.description:
Declare Overlord of the Hauntwoods as an attacker.
Overlord of the Hauntwoods triggers, creating two tapped Everywhere land tokens.
When the Everywhere tokens enter the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko and Lotus Cobra each trigger twice.
Resolve both Lotus Cobra triggers, adding {1}{G}.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Resolve the second Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When the Overlord of the Hauntwoods tokens enters the battlefield, they trigger.
Resolve the first trigger, creating two tapped Everywhere land tokens.
Repeat from step 3.

573-1479-5702.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
573-1479-5702.description:
Play Gruul Turf.
When Gruul Turf enters the battlefield, it, Springheart Nantuko, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Gruul Turf trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Gruul Turf from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Gruul Turf enters the battlefield, it and Springheart Nantuko trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

1140-1636-3143-5455.easyPrerequisites:
You control at least one Forest Dryad token.
Xavier Sal does not have summoning sickness.
There is a counter on a permanent you control.
1140-1636-3143-5455.description:
Activate Xavier Sal by tapping it and removing a counter from a permanent you control, creating a token copy of the Forest Dryad token.
When the Forest Dryad enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm and Bristly Bill trigger.
Resolve the Bristly Bill trigger, putting a counter on a creature you control.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

457-5078-5390-5645.description:
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0}.
Forensic Gadgeteer triggers, creating a Clue token.
Activate Urza's first ability by tapping the Clue, adding {U}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield on top of your library.
Activate the Clue by paying {1} and sacrificing it, causing you to draw Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library.
Repeat.

1978-2341-4176.notablePrerequisites:
Karn is not your commander.
You control at least one additional artifact.
1978-2341-4176.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Karn triggers.
Holding priority, activate The Peregrine Dynamo by paying {1}, copying Karn's ability.
Resolve the copy of Karn's ability, adding at least {C}{C}{C}{C} that cannot be spent to cast nonartifact spells.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping The Peregrine Dynamo.
Repeat from step 2.

2292-2835-4191-5010.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Golgari Thug.
When Golgari Thug dies, it and Fecundity trigger.
Resolve the Golgari Thug trigger, putting it on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Fecundity trigger, causing you to draw Golgari Thug from the top of your library.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability from step 1, causing you to scry 1.
Cast Golgari Thug by paying {0} due to Aluren.
Repeat.

1371-1827-1860-3765.description:
Activate Emergence Zone's second ability by paying {1} and tapping it, allowing you to cast spells this turn as though they have flash.
Cast Vampiric Tutor by paying {B}.
Hive Mind triggers, causing each opponent to create a copy of Vampiric Tutor.
Holding priority, cast Worldfire by paying {6}{R}{R}{R}.
Hive Mind triggers, causing each opponent to create a copy of Worldfire.
Resolve each Worldfire on the stack, exiling all permanents, all cards in all hands and graveyards, and setting each player's life total to one.
Resolve the first opponent's copy of Vampiric Tutor, causing them to search their library for a card, put it on top of their library and lose 2 life.
The opponent loses the game due to having less than zero life.
Repeat from step 7 for each remaining opponent.

647-1520-3259-4314.notablePrerequisites:
Breath of Fury attached to Pawn of Ulamog.
You control an additional nontoken Vampire.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
647-1520-3259-4314.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Pawn of Ulamog.
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice Pawn of Ulamog, attach Breath of Fury to another nontoken Vampire you control, untap all creatures you control and get an additional combat phase after this one.
Pawn of Ulamog dies, triggering itself and Timothar.
Resolve the Pawn of Ulamog trigger, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Resolve the Timothar trigger, causing you to pay {1} and exile Pawn of Ulamog to create a 1/1 Bat creature token.
Move to your next combat phase, and deal combat damage to an opponent using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached, as well as the Bat token.
The Bat and Breath of Fury trigger.
Resolve the Bat's trigger, causing you to sacrifice it and return Pawn of Ulamog from exile to the battlefield tapped.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, attach Breath of Fury to Pawn of Ulamog, untap all creatures you control and get an additional combat phase after this one.
The Vampire dies, triggering Pawn of Ulamog and Timothar.
Resolve the Pawn of Ulamog trigger, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Resolve the Timothar trigger, causing you to pay {1} and exile the Vampire to create a 1/1 Bat creature token.
 Move to your next combat phase, and deal combat damage to an opponent using Pawn of Ulamog and the Bat token.
The Bat and Breath of Fury trigger.
Resolve the Bat's trigger, causing you to sacrifice it and return the Vampire from exile to the battlefield tapped.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice Pawn of Ulamog, attach Breath of Fury to another nontoken Vampire you control, untap all creatures you control and get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat from step 3.

431-1308-1744.description:
Cast Rite of Replication with kicker by paying {7}{U}{U}, creating ten token copies of Lullmage Mentor.
Whenever an opponent casts a spell, activate a Lullmage Mentor by tapping seven Merfolk you control, countering that spell.
Each Lullmage Mentor triggers, creating twice that many 1/1 Merfolk creature tokens.
Repeat from step 2.

1367-2963-4628.notablePrerequisites: Kaho does not have summoning sickness.
1367-2963-4628.description:
Activate Kaho by paying {7} and tapping it, casting Nexus of Fate from exile without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Nexus of Fate, taking an extra turn after this one and shuffling it into your library.
At the beginning of your end step, Teleportation Circle triggers, blinking Kaho.
Kaho enters the battlefield, searching your library for Nexus of Fate and exiling it.
Repeat each turn.
